content.rendered:
The Middleton office will be closed beginning Tuesday, June 27th and will reopen Monday, August 14th. Our office hours are 7:30-3:30.

If you need help with registration or any other matter, please contact the District Office at 503-825-5000. Their summer office hours are 8:00-4:00. The offices are located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd.

We will see you back here on the first day of school, Wednesday, August 30th.
